headline: Grand Slam of Darts round two starts at 2:00 PM New York time, with Littler v Wattimena on the card, and Chelsea host PSG in the Women's Champions League at 3:00 PM.
today: 2:00 PM: Grand Slam of Darts, round two (Cross v Springer, Price v Searle, Littler v Wattimena, Doets v Menzies), ESPN+/Hulu Live.
3:00 PM: Chelsea v Paris Saint-Germain, Women's Champions League, Paramount+.
TBC: Grand Slam of Curling, The National in Sydney, Nova Scotia, ESPN+.

recaps.text: England beat Australia by 97 runs in the third ODI in Hobart to win the series 2-1, with Ben Duckett making 133 from 115 balls.
Luke Humphries, Michael van Gerwen and Nathan Aspinall won their groups on the last night of the Grand Slam of Darts group stage.

lookAhead: Saturday has the first T20I from the MCG at 3:15 AM, England v New Zealand at 9:10 AM and Arsenal at Newcastle at 12:30 PM; Sunday has the Grand Slam final at 2:30 PM and the Jets at the Chargers at 4:05 PM.
